issue: dns.strategy parity gap: custom include-split path omits the !Tun.Ipv6Enabled guard that ConfigGenerator.cs:995 applies, so ForceIpv4Only=false + Ipv6Enabled=false (default) leaves AAAA enabled on an IPv4-only TUN
fix: In StripUnsupportedFeatures step 1d (or in Inject alongside the full/exclude guard at line 259), also force ipv4_only when !settings.Tun.Ipv6Enabled, mirroring ConfigGenerator.BuildDns line 995: change the condition to if (forceIpv4Only || !ipv6Enabled) and pass settings.Tun.Ipv6Enabled through.

issue: EnsureUrltest hardcodes tag "auto" without checking whether an existing non-urltest outbound already carries that tag; a user config with a VLESS outbound tagged "auto" referenced by a selector gets a duplicate-tag FATAL at sing-box start
fix: Before creating the urltest, scan outbounds for any existing entry tagged "auto"; if found either skip injection or pick a collision-free tag (e.g. "vpnrouter-auto").
